verdict.rationale: Stripe's CLI docs explicitly offer a sandbox ('Create a sandbox: Start building on Stripe without needing to set up an account') and describe the CLI as a tool to build and test integrations, which covers the core of testing outside production. Separation from production data is only implied, not documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox/test data is isolated from live data, invoicing-specific sandbox or test-mode guidance (e.g., test clocks or test payments for invoices), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
